Q3.summary: `hermes chat --query-file <file> --oneshot --format stream-json --max-turns 12` took a 30,079-byte brief from a file, worked in the worktree it was started in (commands ran in `<scratch>/wt`) and committed there, but that run was still writing its final reply when the probe's 300 s limit ended it; shorter `chat -q` and `-z` runs ended on their own; `-z` takes the prompt only as an argument; exit codes: success 0 (`-z` H2, `chat` H7), failure 2 from `-z` (unknown model H13, provider error D2) and 1 from `chat` (D3, no provider C0-chat), reached iteration limit 1 from `chat` with the text `I ran out of steps for this turn` (H3b).

Q4.summary: A scratch HERMES_HOME (under `<scratch>/home`) whose `config.yaml` holds `mcp_servers.orchestrator` gave each run its own shim (started by that home's gateway), the run found its credential in the copied `.env` and `auth.json` there, and ~/.hermes/config.yaml kept its hash across every run; hermes copies the scratch `config.yaml`, fake token included, to `backups/config/config.yaml.good.<time>` in the same scratch home.

Q5.summary: initialize answers protocolVersion 1, agentInfo hermes-agent 0.0.0, loadSession, promptCapabilities.image and session fork/list/resume, with one auth method `hermes-setup` (terminal); a stdio server named on session/new is started per session by the gateway daemon, not by `hermes acp`, with `session/new.cwd` as its cwd, registered as `editor_orchestrator_<8 hex>`, and a second session/new got a shim process of its own; during a turn the shim is started again for the turn (A2: discovery shim, then the turn's shim).

Q6.summary: The shim gets only the entry's env plus HOME, LANG, PATH, TMPDIR, USER and __CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING (no HERMES_HOME, no PROBE_MARKER=from-client-env), so ORCH_* must be listed in env or read with --orch-env-file (both worked); the model sees `mcp__orchestrator__heartbeat|report|block|inbox|log` headless and `mcp__editor_orchestrator_<8 hex>__<tool>` over ACP, not the documented `mcp_<server>_<tool>`, and reaches them through Hermes's deferred `tool_search`/`tool_describe` tools before calling them.

Q7.summary: A shim command that exits 1 does not stop the run: the gateway tried it four times and logged `registered 0 tool(s) ... 1 failed: orchestrator`, the model answered `done` without the heartbeat it was asked for, stream-json says nothing about it and `chat` exited 0 (H7); over ACP session/new succeeds and only the gateway log says the server failed discovery (A0-bad).

Q8.summary: The default limit of an MCP tool call is 300 s, both headless and over ACP: a `block` answered after 310 s was cut at 300.0 s (`MCP call timed out after 300.0s (configured timeout: 300.0s)`), so a 200 s block is not cut; `timeout: 430` on the `mcp_servers.orchestrator` entry lifted it and the 310 s answer came through (H8x); a server named over ACP has no timeout field and was cut at 300 s, and the installed source resolves its limit from `timeouts.mcp.tool_call` in the home's config.yaml, which was not run (A8b dropped at the run cap).
Q8.reason: the ACP lift (`timeouts.mcp.tool_call`, scenario A8b) was not run: run cap

Q9.summary: The shim's tools were called without any approval under the default trust (H2, H3, H8a); under `chat -q` a dangerous command (`rm -r <abs path in the worktree>`) is refused at once with `BLOCKED: Command flagged as dangerous (delete in root path) but single-query mode (-q) runs without a user present ... set approvals.single_query_mode: approve`, the model gets that text, the run goes on and exits 0 (H9c); any relative `rm -r ./x` is hardline-blocked as a delete of the runtime's own virtualenv, even under approvals.mode off, because the guard resolves it against the gateway's cwd, which is in the hermes install (H9a, H9b, H10a); `-z` with an absolute path and the smart-mode auxiliary call were not observed (no auxiliary approval call in H9b's usage or H9c's log).
Q9.reason: `-z` with a dangerous absolute-path command and a smart-mode judgement were not run: run cap

Q10.summary: `approvals.mode: off` in the scratch config.yaml removed the wait: under `chat -q` the absolute `rm -r` ran (exit_code 0, target removed) and the scratch config.yaml kept its hash, though hermes wrote a copy of it under backups/ (H8x); `--toolsets file,mcp-orchestrator` with `tools.include` on the entry removed the terminal and the `log` tool from the model's tool list, so the model reported them missing rather than getting an error (H10b); the hardline guard applies whatever the mode; `--yolo`, `HERMES_YOLO_MODE=1`, `trust: full`, `approvals.single_query_mode: approve` and `command_allowlist` were not run.
Q10.reason: --yolo, HERMES_YOLO_MODE, trust: full and command_allowlist were not run: run cap

Q11.summary: Over ACP a dangerous command arrives as session/request_permission with five options (allow_once, allow_session and allow_always of kind allow_always, deny of kind reject_once, deny_always) and names the command in toolCall.rawInput.command, toolCall.title (`delete in root path: rm -r ...`) and the content text; after `deny` the model got `BLOCKED: Command denied by user ... Do NOT retry` and the turn went on to end_turn (A11c); ordinary commands and MCP calls asked nothing (A2, A8a); the 30 s approvals.timeout with no answer was not observed, because A11b's relative path was hardline-blocked before any request.

Q12.summary: Headless with the local terminal backend the agent wrote greeting.txt and ran `git add greeting.txt && git commit -m "probe: greeting"` in the linked worktree: commit a6b8aa2 on task/PROBE/l1, a clean status, and main unchanged; the commit over ACP was not tried.

Q13.summary: `--provider nous -m qwen/qwen4-max:free` took effect (the stream-json `system` line and the usage file name the model and provider); model names have a slash and a colon, so they fail MODEL_PATTERN and fit OPENCODE_MODEL_PATTERN; an unknown model on `-z` exits 2 with `Model 'probe-no-such-model-9' isn't available on Nous Portal` and the provider's 404 on stdout, and a usage file with failed true; the effort option is `--reasoning none..ultra`; over ACP model ids are `<provider>:<model>`, session/set_model refuses an unknown one with -32603 model_resolution_failed and session/set_config_option for model or effort answers an empty configOptions.

Q14.summary: The `--usage-file` holds estimated_cost_usd (0, cost_status `estimated`, cost_source `provider_models_api`), input/output/cache_read/cache_write/reasoning/total tokens, api_calls, model, provider, session_id, completed/partial/interrupted/failed, turn_exit_reason, an `auxiliary` block (title generation) and total_including_auxiliary, so the main totals leave auxiliary calls out; the stream-json `result` holds session_id, exit_code, text, tokens (input, output, total, cache_read, cache_write) and duration_ms, and tokens.input includes the cache reads and writes; ACP's session/prompt result carries usage inputTokens (without the cache), cachedReadTokens, outputTokens, thoughtTokens and totalTokens, with no cost.

Q15.summary: No credential: `-z` and `chat` exit 1 with `It looks like Hermes isn't configured yet`, ACP session/new -32603 storage_unavailable or session/prompt -32603 admitted_turn_failed; unknown model: `-z` exit 2 with the provider's 404 text, ACP set_model -32603 model_resolution_failed; a shim that did not start: no output at all, exit 0, only the gateway log; a denied command: the BLOCKED text goes to the model and `chat -q` exits 0, over ACP a tool_call_update `failed` and end_turn; a reached iteration limit: `chat` exit 1 with `I ran out of steps for this turn`.
